headline: Head of Software Engineering · Distributed Systems · Platform & Architecture
summary: Technical leader experienced in scaling high-traffic systems, modernising legacy platforms, and leading engineering teams to deliver resilient, high-quality software at pace.

highlights: Lead a team of 10 engineers across 2 teams delivering multiple high-priority projects to aggressive timelines. Projected for £1.8M revenue in the first year.
Own the technical strategy and architectural decisions for high-traffic web platforms.
Modernised legacy technology and introduced scalable platform patterns to improve reliability and meet CE+ regulations.
Mentor engineers across seniority levels to increase their ownership and system comprehension.
Led the creation of a brand new micro-learning platform. Ran discovery with stakeholders, architected the solution, managed budgets, and sourced staff.
Implemented ways of working for the newly formed team and drove agile practices.
Led the digital transformation from a legacy system to a serverless AWS solution, and the transition to git. Deployment velocity and customer satisfaction both went up.
Led projects for the digital transformation of an education business. Saved over $300,000 in cloud costs while increasing system capacity and resiliency.

Built large-scale web applications across housing surveying and meal delivery, and introduced source control, deployment procedures, and server tooling to the team.
Lead developer of a parents evening product used by over 150,000 parents across 700 schools in 3 countries.
Built an API that handles the sending of over 500,000 parent invitations at once.
